summary: Frontend testing of teacher-branch assignment bugfix. Logged in as all 4 teachers (İlknur, Buse, Sıla, Ayşegül) and admin. Verified /teacher/content correctly filters books by teacher's assigned branch AND subtitle shows correct branch name. Admin teachers list shows all 4 teachers.

issues: Teacher list cards do not display branch names directly on the card (only visible via Profil/Düzenle). Consider adding branch badge to each teacher card for quicker admin overview.

critical_code_review_comments: TeacherHomeworkContent.jsx correctly uses /teachers/{id}/branches -> filters books client-side by branch_id. Works correctly.
Minor: admin teachers list doesn't show branch assignment info in card summary; users must click Profil to verify.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified: teacher_branches assignments now correctly filter books. İlknur→Türkçe→'Yeni kitap Türkçe', Buse→Fen Bilimleri→'Yeni kitap Fen denemesi', Sıla→Matematik→'Yeni kitap Matematik', Ayşegül→Fen Bilimleri→'Yeni kitap Fen denemesi'. Subtitles on /teacher/content correctly show branch name (e.g., 'Türkçe branşı için kitap ve içerik yönetimi'). No wrong books leaked across branches.
rca of the issue: Previously teacher_branches table had incorrect mappings causing books from wrong branches to show. Backend fixed the mappings. Frontend TeacherHomeworkContent.jsx already filters by teacherData.branches from GET /teachers/{id}, so once DB was correct, UI worked correctly with no code changes required. Verified via UI: all 4 teachers see only their branch's book, subtitle displays correct branch text.
